claim: Using predefined thresholds to filter unnecessary communication reduces communication overhead.
falsifier: One can implement a multi-agent system with threshold-based communication filtering and measure the communication overhead (e.g., number of messages sent) compared to a baseline without filtering.

conditions: Communication is filtered based on thresholds
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the VBC and TMC methods and their reported experimental conditions; transfer beyond those settings is unestablished.

title: Using predefined thresholds for communication overhead
